block.title: The getopt proof follows a compiler temporary through a rename
block.p: The scanner promises to preserve registers that its blocks never assign. Five steps of the proof used to list those assignments by hand. They now read the instruction results and phi nodes from the captured blocks. Rocq checked that all five lists have exactly the same contents in the same order as before.

In a scratch capture we renamed the temporary holding the address of the last nonoption. The clamp proof passed without edits. Restoring the handwritten list made the same proof fail when it had to show that the block preserved the caller's registers.

The two scanner modes now share one proof at the test for "--". The mode that skips nonoptions first borrows the two index cells it needs for the loop. The other mode passes the four named fields directly from the clamp to the shared test.
